testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.app.definition.DataSourceSlotCommitTests

testcase.name: a slot with a sourceRef or a credential is refused with 400 and nothing is stored()
a project declares, renames and removes a slot through PATCH schema - each edit is an immutable audited version()
removing a slot that a query still uses is rejected with 422 and the path of the dangling reference()
a duplicate slot and an unknown slot are refused over HTTP()
